title: Why You Feel Hungry at the Same Time Every Day
hook: Still wonder why you crave lunch at exactly 1pm?

narration.text: That midday hunger isn't always about your stomach needing food.
Your body learns to expect food at specific times, a conditioned response.
When the clock nears your usual mealtime, your brain anticipates food.
It starts releasing digestive enzymes and hormones, making you feel genuinely hungry.
This conditioned hunger can be so powerful, it overrides actual energy needs.
You might feel ravenous, even if you had a big breakfast just hours ago.
Recognising this pattern can help you understand your body's signals better.
Do you notice your hunger arriving like clockwork?

description: Ever wonder why hunger strikes at the same time daily, even if you've eaten recently? It's often not just about an empty stomach but a fascinating conditioned response from your brain. Your body anticipates food, releasing hormones that make you feel truly hungry.
topic: Why you often feel a wave of hunger at a specific time each day, explaining conditioned hunger responses.
